text: Marine technology and engineering aims to "expand human capabilities for marine activities and achieve sustainable development of marine resources as well as protection of marine ecology". The research scope covers the vast marine space from the coastal areas to the deep sea. The core tasks include: Develop engineering technologies suitable for marine environments (such as wind-resistant marine platforms, deep-sea exploration equipment with high pressure resistance);Design and construct marine engineering facilities (such as ports, cross-sea bridges, submarine pipelines, offshore wind farms);Develop marine resources (such as oil and gas, minerals, biological resources, renewable energy) while taking into account ecological protection;Monitor and address marine environmental issues (such as storm surge warning, marine pollution control).
